candidate_source_reviews.title: City of Ekurhuleni 2027 Community Bursary Programme
candidate_source_reviews.source_status_evidence: Official City page says applications are currently open and close Monday 30 November 2026.
candidate_source_reviews.eligibility_summary: South African citizens permanently resident in Ekurhuleni; age 18–35; Grade 12 completed; 2027 acceptance letter or registration proof; annual household income not above R600,000. Supports selected full-time undergraduate fields at accredited SA universities, universities of technology and TVET colleges, including listed technical/artisan/apprenticeship qualifications.
required_evidence: 2027 acceptance letter or proof of registration
Proof of Ekurhuleni residence not older than three months
candidate_source_reviews.application_method: Register and activate a profile at the official City bursary portal, select Community Bursary, then Apply.

candidate_source_reviews.title: Funza Lushaka Bursary Programme — 2027 intake
candidate_source_reviews.authority: Department of Basic Education / Department of Education
candidate_source_reviews.source_status_evidence: Official Department article says 2027 applications opened 1 October 2026; first-time applications close 31 January 2027 and returning bursar applications close 30 November 2026.
candidate_source_reviews.eligibility_summary: Targeted at youth below 30 with a matric Bachelor’s pass or who meet university entry requirements. Programme supports prospective teachers in priority areas; phase, subject, institution and other detailed eligibility must be checked against current programme guidelines before candidate matching.
candidate_source_reviews.benefits_summary: Published programme description lists tuition, accommodation or transport, meals, learning materials, personal-care allowance and teaching-practice support.
candidate_source_reviews.application_method: Apply online through the official eServices portal. The Department article says district officials can assist with online application issues.

candidate_source_reviews.title: UCT Postgraduate Financial Aid Bursary — 2027
candidate_source_reviews.source_status_evidence: UCT official page says 2027 applications are open and the 2027 online funding application deadline is 10 November 2026.
candidate_source_reviews.eligibility_summary: For South African citizens and permanent residents at Honours, Master’s or Doctoral level; all fields. First-year applicants must submit a 2027 UCT admissions application before applying for postgraduate funding. Selection is holistic, not based solely on academic merit; detailed criteria must be checked in UCT funding guidelines.
candidate_source_reviews.application_method: UCT Postgraduate Online Funding Application in the PeopleSoft Student Portal. Late or incomplete applications are not considered.

candidate_source_reviews.title: 2027 NRF Honours General Call — UCT funding noticeboard entry
candidate_source_reviews.authority: National Research Foundation / University of Cape Town funding noticeboard
candidate_source_reviews.source_status_evidence: UCT funding noticeboard lists a 15 November 2026 internal closing date. UCT NRF guidance page contains a category-specific note that Honours applicants requiring ISFAP assessment must apply by 14 August 2026; this category distinction requires manual reconciliation.
candidate_source_reviews.eligibility_summary: Honours funding. Full NRF call, discipline eligibility, ISFAP category and applicant requirements must be checked before publication. Do not treat all Honours applicants as eligible for the 15 November date.
candidate_source_reviews.application_method: NRF Connect online application is stated in UCT’s NRF guidance; confirm exact category and internal UCT process.

candidate_source_reviews.title: ABB Education Trust Bursary — 2027
candidate_source_reviews.authority: Cape Peninsula University of Technology / ABB Education Trust
candidate_source_reviews.source_status_evidence: Current CPUT Bursary Opportunities page search result lists applications opening 2 November 2026 at 08:00 and closing 14 November 2026 at 16:00.
candidate_source_reviews.eligibility_summary: Mandatory criteria published by CPUT: Black female South African citizens; first year completed with at least 60% pass aggregate; household income below R600,000 per annum; repeat courses and outstanding balances are not funded. Disability inclusion is encouraged. Preference given to Electrical, Mechanical and Industrial Engineering degree or higher diploma streams.
candidate_source_reviews.application_method: Official CPUT bursary page exposes an Online Application action, but the exact 2027 form URL was not resolved in this review. Reopen the official page and capture the direct form link before candidate-facing use.

candidate_source_reviews.title: Information and Communication Technology Developer — POST 38/236
candidate_source_reviews.authority: The Presidency, Republic of South Africa
candidate_source_reviews.source_status_evidence: Official Presidency vacancy page indexed 4 November 2026 says published 26 October 2026 and closing Friday 6 November 2026; it specifies email submissions by midnight and hand delivery by 16:30.
candidate_source_reviews.eligibility_summary: Senior Certificate plus an appropriate Bachelor’s degree or National Diploma in Information Technology, or an equivalent NQF Level 6 qualification; 3–5 years’ relevant systems-development experience according to SDLC.
required_evidence: Completed and signed current Z83 form
candidate_source_reviews.application_method: Email applications@presidency.gov.za for the attention of Ms L Mphahlele, or hand deliver to Government Avenue, Union Buildings, Pretoria. The advert says only the signed Z83 and detailed CV should be attached.
